name: Kansas FMC and Sidekicks 2022

venue.name: Hope Community Church
venue.details: The Commons (in the back of the main building)

information: If COVID cases rise, we may need to cancel this competition; competitors will be notified by email in that case. Please note that this schedule is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, ***all competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, you may want to look at CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial.***
